data.request: teniendo en cuenta el plan realiza la lista de features del Agente B (catálogo). [Fase 0, cambio 5: tokenStore, JWT, Session, sessionController e interceptor de auth.]

data.cmd: fvm dart run build_runner build -d && fvm flutter analyze && fvm flutter test test/core

data.summary: decodeJwt reads sub/email/role/exp into a JwtClaims record (null when malformed or without sub/exp); freezed Session with isExpiredAt/remainingAt; TokenStore interface with a flutter_secure_storage implementation for the token and first names by email.

data.cmd: fvm dart run build_runner build -d && fvm flutter analyze && fvm flutter test test/core

data.summary: keepAlive SessionController restores a live token (drops expired or corrupt ones), login stores the token only on success, register saves first names then logs in, logout, and a synchronous onUnauthorized that raises SessionExpired once; clockProvider for tests.

data.cmd: fvm dart run build_runner build -d && fvm flutter analyze && fvm flutter test

data.summary: AuthInterceptor adds the Bearer token (read from TokenStore per request) except on /api/securities and /health, and calls onUnauthorized on a 401 that carried a token; dioProvider wires it to SessionController.
